title: Io caterpillars queuing · seen from above

reference.grammar: Young Io caterpillars travel nose to tail in a line, each head against the rear of the one ahead; the lead one follows the pointer.

techniques.name: Field-guide plate

panels.title: Io caterpillars queuing · seen from above

techniques.implementation: A specimen drawn in color on black, with charts and measurements set around it.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
notes: Sources: From How a Moth Works · isolated figure
